paragraphs.text: Budget plans are “what if” workspaces. Incomes, recurring payables, and budget targets live here; nothing posts to the ledger until you record it separately.

Overview uses pie charts for a monthly feel (30-day month). Incomes tie to revenue accounts; payables and budgets use budget accounts; funding lines connect income to budgets. The app converts frequencies to daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly figures on a 30/365 basis so you can compare apples to apples.
